description_en: Queries the audit result of a promotional activity for a Sound Broadcast sharing task
description_zh: 调用该接口查询千里传音分享任务的促销活动审核结果
name: QuerySharePromotionActivityAuditResult

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the promotional activity.

This is the Data value returned by the CreateSharePromotionActivity operation
parameters.help_zh:
促销活动ID。

调用接口CreateSharePromotionActivity返回的Data值
parameters.name: share_promotion_activity_id

parameters.help_en:
The share code of the sharing task.

For more information about the share code, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/607661.html
parameters.help_zh:
分享任务的分享码。

分享任务的分享码信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/607661.html
parameters.name: share_task_code

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. You can view the ID of the current instance on the Overview page in the IoT Platform console.

<notice>
If this parameter is available, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.
If this parameter is unavailable, you do not need to specify it.

</notice>

For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页签，查看当前实例的ID。

<notice>
若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
若无ID值，则无需传入。

</notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

Code.description_en:
The result code of the operation:
If the call is successful, an empty value is returned.
If the call fails, an error code is returned. For more information, see Error codes in this topic
Code.description_zh:
调用结果状态码：
调用成功，返回空值。
调用失败，返回错误码。详细信息，请参见下文错误码

Data.description_en: The audit result data returned if the call is successful
Data.description_zh: 调用成功后，返回的审核结果数据

AuditResult.description_en:
The audit result.

1: Pending review.
2: Approved.
3: Rejected
AuditResult.description_zh:
审核结果。

1：待审核。
2：审核通过。
3：审核拒绝

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the call fails
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的出错信息

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call is successful.
true: The call is successful.
false: The call fails
Success.description_zh:
是否调用成功。
true：调用成功。
false：调用失败
